slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
To prove a quadrilateral is a parallelogram, any one of these is enough:

Both pairs of opposite sides are parallel (definition). Both pairs of opposite sides are equal. One pair of opposite sides is both equal and parallel. Both pairs of opposite angles are equal. The diagonals bisect each other.

Each is proved with congruent triangles. Not every property is a test: a quadrilateral with one pair of parallel sides and the other pair equal can be an isosceles trapezoid.
